title: Rewarding Concise Ship Cards
summary: YTIntel update cards now hit the sweet spot: fast to scan, visually rewarding and satisfying to receive without pinging anyone or turning into a wall of text.
discord_changes: A bold SHIP COMPLETE header and gold release card make each shipped update feel like a real win without using @everyone.
Each card shows the live upgrade count, one short outcome and only the three most important improvements.
A tiny +1 release receipt makes progress visible, with one-tap access straight back into the live YTIntel build.
changes: Added a one-line SHIP COMPLETE celebration above the release card while keeping all Discord mentions disabled.
Switched the release card to a warmer gold reward treatment with a trophy/launch hierarchy designed for immediate recognition.
Added a live upgrade count so every release instantly shows how much progress landed.
Kept the body intentionally tight: one short outcome, three highlights maximum and one Open YTIntel action.
Changed the footer to a compact LIVE NOW, +1 release and build receipt so progress feels banked without adding clutter.
Preserved the existing release-burst protection so multi-file work still resolves into one final satisfying Discord card.
why_it_matters: The best release notification should give you a small reward for shipping and still take only a few seconds to understand. This version makes progress feel visible and satisfying without sacrificing scan speed.
